tagline: Leading kidney care provider transforming care delivery to improve patient outcomes and quality of life globally.
hero_kpi_rationale: DaVita is a leader in dialysis services in the United States, with revenue growth of 3.5% based on an increase of $18.24 in average patient services revenue per treatment. This indicator reflects the company's core performance in its main business and its ability to increase revenue per patient.
company_description: DaVita Inc. provides kidney dialysis services for patients suffering from chronic kidney failure in the United States. The company operates kidney dialysis centers and provides related lab services in outpatient dialysis centers. It also offers outpatient, hospital inpatient, and home-based hemodialysis dialysis services; operates clinical laboratories that provide routine laboratory tests for dialysis and other physician-prescribed laboratory tests for ESRD patients; and management and administrative services to outpatient dialysis centers. In addition, the company offers integrated care and disease management services to patients in risk-based and other integrated care arrangements; clinical research programs; physician services; and comprehensive kidney care services. Further, it engages in the transplant software business. The company was formerly known as DaVita HealthCare Partners Inc. and changed its name to DaVita Inc. in September 2016. DaVita Inc. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

risks.title: Global Health Conditions
risks.summary: Global health conditions may reduce the number of patients treated and dialysis volumes, negatively impacting revenue and operating results.
risks.score_rationale: Global health conditions, including epidemics and pandemics, may reduce patient numbers and treatment volumes, having a significant impact on revenue.

risks.title: Government Regulations
risks.summary: Changes in laws and regulations, particularly regarding government reimbursement rates and health insurance coverage, may significantly impact operations and results.
risks.score_rationale: Complex and constantly evolving regulatory changes, including modifications to Medicare and Medicaid reimbursement rates, may result in significant costs and challenges.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary: Increased competition in the dialysis services sector may result in pressure on prices and market share, negatively impacting revenue and results.
risks.score_rationale: Growing competition from new entrants and existing dialysis providers may exert pressure on prices and market share.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Security Incidents
risks.summary: Cyberattacks, including the incident experienced in 2025, may result in loss of sensitive data, operational disruptions and reputational damage.
risks.score_rationale: The cybersecurity incident experienced by the company in 2025 and ongoing data security risks may have a significant impact on confidentiality and reputation.

risks.title: Economic and Inflationary Conditions
risks.summary: Difficult economic conditions including inflation and market volatility may increase labor and material costs, reducing profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Inflation, interest rate fluctuations and difficult economic conditions may increase operating costs and reduce revenue.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.summary: Supply chain disruptions affecting essential clinical supplies and equipment may impact the ability to provide services and increase costs.
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain disruptions, including trade policies and tariffs, may affect the availability and costs of critical supplies.

risks.title: Labor Retention and Costs
risks.summary: Labor market tensions, clinical staff shortages and high turnover may result in significant cost increases and operational challenges.
risks.score_rationale: The national shortage of qualified clinical staff and labor market volatility create significant recruitment and retention challenges.

risks.title: Natural Disasters and Weather Events
risks.summary: Natural disasters may cause service interruptions, equipment losses and significant costs affecting operations and results.
risks.score_rationale: Severe storms, earthquakes and floods may cause operational disruptions and significant financial losses.

ai_positioning.summary: DaVita does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report. The company focuses on dialysis services, integrated kidney care and international operations.
